ModMetaData.name: Nelim's Pickle Tools - Expansions
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Two Pickle steps that ask ModsConfig whether an expansion is active, for a pass that leaves a DLC out. Developer tooling; no Defs, no features. A suite stages it with one line in a pass map. See ExpansionSteps/README.md at the repository root.
Developer test companion for RimWorld 1.6. Requires Pickle; no gameplay content or scenarios included. Enable only for test suites that use these steps. Runtime coverage and limitations are documented in the repository.
